## 08.11 Vendor abstraction layer

Every model call in the product goes through one interface. The Vercel AI SDK 7 carries transport and UI streaming; provider-specific capabilities that the differentiators depend on — Anthropic `cache_control`, effort and citations, Gemini thinking level and context caches, OpenAI reasoning effort, Bedrock/Vertex regional hosts — are exposed through **our** adapter contract using the native SDKs underneath. Why: an abstraction that flattens to the lowest common denominator throws away exactly the features §08.3 and §08.4 are built on [AR§19, AR§21].

### The interface

```ts
// packages/llm/src/contract.ts — the only surface product code may import
export interface ModelAdapter {
  readonly id: ProviderId;                     // 'anthropic' | 'google' | 'openai' | 'deepseek' | ...
  readonly capabilities: Capabilities;         // static, asserted by conformance tests

  complete(req: LlmRequest): Promise<LlmResult>;                 // non-streamed
  stream(req: LlmRequest): AsyncIterable<StreamPart>;            // typed parts (§09.8)
  structured<T>(req: LlmRequest, schema: SchemaRef): Promise<Validated<T>>;  // §08.4
  tools(req: LlmRequest, tools: ToolDef[]): AsyncIterable<StreamPart>;       // allow-listed, §08.5
  vision(req: LlmRequest, images: ImageRef[]): Promise<LlmResult>;
  cache: { plan(blocks: PromptBlock[]): CachePlan; minPrefixTokens(model: string): number };
  batch: { submit(jobs: LlmRequest[]): Promise<BatchHandle>;
           poll(h: BatchHandle): Promise<BatchStatus>; results(h: BatchHandle): AsyncIterable<LlmResult> };
  embed?(texts: string[], opts: EmbedOpts): Promise<Float32Array[]>;
  rerank?(query: string, docs: string[], k: number): Promise<Ranked[]>;
  countTokens(req: LlmRequest): Promise<number>;                 // per-model tokeniser
  health(): Promise<{ ok: boolean; region: string; latencyMs: number }>;
}

export interface LlmRequest {
  route: RouteId;               // 08-RT-0NN — the adapter never infers the route
  policy: PolicyObject;         // §08.8; adapter refuses if host/region/model not permitted
  blocks: PromptBlock[];        // ordered per 08-CACH-001, each {role, content, cacheable}
  effort: 'none' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';   // mapped per provider by the adapter
  maxTokens: number; stopReasonsExpected?: string[];
  schema?: SchemaRef; tools?: ToolDef[]; images?: ImageRef[];
  idempotencyKey: string; traceparent: string;
}

export interface LlmResult {
  text?: string; object?: unknown; toolCalls?: ToolCall[];
  usage: { inTokens: number; outTokens: number; cacheReadTokens: number; cacheWriteTokens: number;
           reasoningTokens?: number };
  costUsd: number;              // computed from config/pricing.yaml + policy uplift (08-COST-001)
  model: string; host: string; region: string; stopReason: string;
  ttftMs: number; totalMs: number; raw: unknown;   // raw kept per 08-SCH-007
}
```

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 08-VND-001 | Product code (orchestrator, marking, retrieval, jobs, UI) imports only `packages/llm`. A direct import of `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@google/genai`, `openai` or an HTTP client to a provider host outside `packages/llm/adapters/*` fails the lint. | ESLint `no-restricted-imports` rule + a CI grep over the monorepo; a planted violation fails the build. |
| 08-VND-002 | **No vendor-specific prompt text in product code or prompts.** Prompts contain no provider names, no "as Claude", no model-specific formatting hacks, no XML-vs-Markdown branching by vendor; provider-shaped wrapping (Anthropic XML block tags, Gemini `systemInstruction` placement, OpenAI developer-message conventions) is applied by the adapter from the neutral `PromptBlock[]`. | Prompt lint: regex over `prompts/` for provider names and model ids = 0 hits; the same golden Turn rendered through three adapters produces the same visible content and passes the same Turn lint. |
| 08-VND-003 | Capability gaps are declared, never emulated silently. If a route asks for a capability the adapter lacks, it throws `CapabilityUnsupported` and the router moves to the next rung (§08.7) with the visible chip — an adapter never quietly drops caching, thinking or a schema. | Fault-injection: force `structured` on an adapter with `strictJson: false`; assert the rung move and the `route.failover` chip, not a degraded answer. |
| 08-VND-004 | Cost, tokens and cache accounting are computed in the adapter from provider usage fields and `config/pricing.yaml`; no caller computes cost. | Adapter unit tests compare against recorded invoices for 100 sampled calls; delta ≤1%. |
| 08-VND-005 | Idempotency: retries reuse `idempotencyKey`; a stream that has emitted a token is never retried (08-DEGR-006). | Replay test: forced 529 after first token yields one partial, no duplicate charge. |

### Capability matrix

`capabilities` is a static object per adapter, asserted by the conformance suite; the router reads it to plan routes and ladders.

| Capability | Anthropic (1P / Vertex / Bedrock) | Google (1P / Vertex) | OpenAI (1P / Azure) | DeepSeek |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Streaming (typed parts) | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Effort / thinking control | `effort: low\|medium\|high`, summarized thinking | thinking level + budget | `reasoning.effort` | thinking `max` |
| Prompt caching | explicit `cache_control`, 5 m/1 h TTL, min prefix 512/1,024/4,096 by model | explicit context caches, storage billed per hour | automatic, 90% discount, no control | none — assume 0% cache |
| Structured outputs | strict schema / strict tools | `response_json_schema` | strict JSON schema | JSON mode + post-validation |
| Citations in-response | yes (mutually exclusive with schemas, 08-SCH-006) | grounding metadata | no | no |
| Tool calls | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Vision | yes (high-res tier costs up to ~3× tokens) | yes, cheapest | yes | no |
| Batch (−50%) | yes | yes | yes | off-peak pricing |
| Server-side code execution | yes (sandbox) | yes | yes | no |
| Regional hosts | Vertex `europe-west2/4`, Bedrock `eu-central-1` | Vertex regional | Azure `swedencentral` | none |
| ZDR / no-training assertion | per-org ZDR; Fable 5.1 excluded (30-day retention) | Vertex terms | ZDR on request | not used for PII (08-POL-002) |
| Embeddings / rerank | no | yes | yes | no |
| Realtime voice | no | Gemini Live | yes | no |

**08-VND-006** The matrix is data, not prose: `capabilities.json` per adapter, and `routing.yaml` validation fails if a route requires a capability its primary or any ladder rung lacks. *Acceptance:* a PR pointing the Mark route at a `strictJson: false` provider fails CI with the offending capability named.

### Conformance and onboarding

**08-VND-007 Adapter conformance suite** (`pnpm test:adapters`, run per PR against record/replay fixtures and nightly against live providers with a $5/day cap): 60 cases per adapter — a plain completion; a stream with mid-stream cancellation; a stream that is cut and resumed; typed part ordering; a 4-block cached prompt asserting `cacheReadTokens > 0` on the second call; a below-minimum prefix asserting no cache write is attempted; a strict-schema call with a valid and an invalid response plus one repair; three tool calls including one typed error; a vision call with a 2,000 px downsample; a batch of 20 with poll and partial failure; token counting within ±2% of the provider's own counter; cost within ±1% of the price table; a 429 with `retry-after`; a 529; a refusal `stop_reason`; a policy violation (forbidden host) refused before the socket opens; and a redaction assertion (no `pii_fields` in the outbound payload). *Acceptance:* every adapter passes all 60 or is not registered in `routing.yaml`.

**08-VND-008 Feature flags.** Each adapter is behind `provider.<id>.enabled` and each capability behind `provider.<id>.cap.<name>` (11-CICD-003), so a provider incident is a flag flip, not a deploy, and a newly onboarded provider ships dark. Flags carry an owner and a 30-day expiry for `release`-class flags.

**08-VND-009 Onboarding a new provider in <1 week** — the checklist is the definition of done: day 1 adapter skeleton + `capabilities.json` + pricing rows with `valid_from`; day 2 conformance suite green on record/replay; day 3 live-key conformance in `staging`, region and residency mapping added to `endpoints` (§08.8) and to `/legal/subprocessors` with the 30-day tenant objection window opened (11-PRIV-007); day 4 route table entry as a **ladder rung only**, behind a dark flag; day 5 §08.9 gates on the routes it can serve; day 6–7 canary at 5%. Promotion to a *primary* route always requires the full per-paper marking gates or the full pedagogy suite for the class it would serve. *Acceptance:* a rehearsal in M4 onboards one unused provider end-to-end inside five working days, evidenced by the PR trail; no product-code file changes in that PR other than config.

## 08.12 Logging and observability per call

One row per model call, one span per model call, the same field names everywhere. §11.11 owns the infrastructure (Langfuse 4 self-hosted, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, ClickHouse roll-ups) and the SLO paging policy; this subsection fixes the payload so that cost (§08.10), routing (§08.2), degradation (§08.7), evals (§08.9) and the learner-facing provenance chip (§12.9) all read the same fields.

### The per-call record

Emitted by the adapter (§08.11) on every completion, stream close, batch item and tool call. `class` marks how the field is treated by the redaction filter: **M** metadata (always kept), **P** pseudonymous, **C** content (governed by `logging_level`, §08.8).

| Field | Type | Class | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `trace_id`, `span_id`, `parent_span_id` | string | M | `4bf92f…` | W3C `traceparent`; linkage below |
| `tenant_id`, `tenant_type`, `residency` | string | M | `t_school_042`, `school`, `eu` | from the policy object |
| `user_hash` | string | P | `u_9f3c…` | HMAC-SHA256 of `user_id` with a per-environment key; never the raw id, never email |
| `age_band`, `consent_mode` | enum | M | `13_15`, `school` | drives redaction defaults |
| `course_id`, `session_id`, `item_id`, `attempt_id`, `turn_id`, `mark_id` | string | P | `c_88f1`, `s_…`, `9609/22/M/J/24/Q3b`, … | nullable per route (an Ask has no `course_id`) |
| `syllabus_points[]` | string[] | P | `["9609/3.2.1"]` | for per-topic cost and quality cuts |
| `policy_version`, `prompt_name`, `prompt_version`, `pack_version`, `schema_id`, `routing_rev` | string | M | `2026.09.2`, `learn.system`, `v31`, `9609:2026.3`, `mark.v1`, `412` | the §08.9 manifest, resolvable to an exact replay |
| `route_expected`, `route_actual`, `route_rung`, `cache_break_reason`, `failover_reason` | string/int | M | `08-RT-001`, `08-RT-001`, `0`, `null`, `null` | 08-PRIN-001 asserts equality ≥95% |
| `provider`, `model`, `host`, `provider_region` | string | M | `anthropic`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `vertex`, `europe-west4` | residency audits query these |
| `effort`, `max_tokens`, `thinking_display` | enum/int | M | `medium`, `400`, `summarized` | |
| `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cache_read_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens`, `reasoning_tokens` | int | M | `12840`, `212`, `11190`, `0`, `640` | `cache_hit = cache_read_tokens > 0`; `cache_read_share` derived |
| `cost_usd`, `cost_uplift_pct`, `billing_mode` | float/enum | M | `0.0113`, `10`, `interactive\|batch` | computed in the adapter (08-VND-004) |
| `ttft_ms`, `total_ms`, `queue_ms`, `retries`, `hedged` | int/bool | M | `640`, `4210`, `0`, `0`, `false` | budgets in §08.2 |
| `stop_reason`, `error_class`, `http_status` | string | M | `end_turn`, `null`, `200` | `refusal` is a safety event |
| `intent`, `rung`, `gate_state`, `effort_gate_latency_ms` | enum/int | P | `check_steps`, `3`, `passed`, `6100` | §04 fields on Learn Turns |
| `lint_result` | object | M | `{"turn":"pass","praise":"pass","words":88,"questions":1,"leak":false}` | a failed lint blocks the paint (§04.8) |
| `tool_calls[]` | object[] | M | `[{"name":"verify_math","ok":true,"ms":810,"result_tokens":180}]` | names only, never arguments, unless `logging_level: full` |
| `verified` | bool | M | `true` | 08-TOOL-001 requires it on numeric finals |
| `safety_flags[]`, `affect_tag`, `classifier_conf` | string[]/enum/float | P | `[]`, `neutral`, `0.97` | 04.9 / §12 |
| `calibration_status`, `second_marker`, `agreement`, `signed_error` | object/string/float | M | `provisional`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `1_level`, `+0.2` | Mark routes only (§08.6) |
| `experiment_arms[]`, `flags[]` | string[] | M | `["debt_guard:L1"]` | §13 registry |
| `prompt_content`, `completion_content`, `retrieved_chunk_ids[]` | text/string[] | C | — | `chunk_ids` are M; the chunk text is C |
| `sampled_for_eval`, `seeded_qa` | bool | M | `false`, `true` | seeded Marks are invisible to the student (08-ENS-005) |

**08-LOG-001** Every field above is present on every call (nullable where the route makes it meaningless); a call missing `policy_version`, `route_actual`, `cost_usd` or `user_hash` is a CI failure and, in production, an alert. *Acceptance:* a schema check on the trace exporter rejects incomplete spans; a synthetic incomplete span pages in staging.

### Trace linkage

**08-LOG-002** One trace per user action. Span hierarchy: `request` → `policy.resolve` → `classifier` (parallel) → `retrieval` (`embed`, `search`, `rerank`) → `llm.call` (one per model call, including each failover rung and each self-consistency run) → `tool.*` → `validate` → `lint` → `persist` (Attempt/Turn/Mark write). Background work joins by link, not by parent: a batch job carries `links[]` to the Attempt trace that caused it (Card generation, pre-solve, second mark), so a Mark shown to a student resolves to every call that produced it. The `mark_id` and `turn_id` are queryable keys in Langfuse, so "show me every call behind this Mark" is one lookup — the same lookup the support tool and the appeal reviewer use. *Acceptance:* pick 20 random Marks; each resolves to a complete call set including the second marker and any repair call, with no orphan spans.

**08-LOG-003** Client to server: the web and Expo clients propagate `traceparent` on the stream request and report `first_paint_ms`, `stream_resumes`, `abandon_before_first_token` back onto the same trace, so a latency complaint is answerable end to end (§11.14 budgets).

### Redaction and retention

**08-LOG-004** The redaction filter runs **before** the trace leaves the process, not in the pipeline: `logging_level: none` drops all C fields at source; `redacted` applies the `pii_rules` scrubber (names, contacts, school names, faces blurred on images, free-text scrub) and stores a content hash for eval replay; `full` is permitted only for consenting `18plus` consumers and synthetic tenants (08-POL-005). Teen bands are pinned to `none`. Retrieved chunk text is stored as ids only unless `full`. *Acceptance:* a provider-payload and trace-payload lint in CI fails on any `pii_fields` name; a teen-tenant soak produces zero C fields across 24 h.

**08-LOG-005** Retention follows 11-PRIV-004: traces `none` metadata 90 days, `redacted` 30 days, `full` 14 days; `raw_output` for schema routes 90 days (08-SCH-007) subject to the tenant's `retention_days`; account deletion purges traces keyed by `user_hash` within 7 days, which is why `user_hash` — not a raw id — is the join key everywhere. Metrics roll-ups are aggregate-only and survive deletion (they contain no `user_hash` beyond k ≥ 20 buckets). *Acceptance:* the deletion-SLA test asserts zero trace rows for the deleted `user_hash` at hour 168, and that the cost dashboard totals are unchanged by the deletion.

### Dashboards and alerts

**08-LOG-006** Build these on the §11.11 infrastructure; do not duplicate its paging policy. Dashboards: *Routing* (`route_expected == route_actual` rate, rung distribution, failover reasons by provider/region); *Cost* (§08.10 report inputs live, per route/model/tenant, cache-read share, batch share); *Latency* (TTFT p50/p95 by route and region, first-AO-card, tool time, queue time); *Quality* (lint pass rate, leak and praise sample rates, repair rate, schema failures, `verified` share on STEM finals, per-paper QWK and challenge rate); *Safety* (affect tags, refusals, classifier fail-closed events); *Policy* (EU/UK calls by `provider_region`, DeepSeek calls by job class, ZDR excluded-model attempts). Alerts that page (11-OBS-005 owns the routing): any EU/UK call to a non-European `provider_region`; any DeepSeek call with `pii=true` or a non-permitted job class; `route_expected != route_actual` >5% for 10 min; cache-read share <50% for 30 min; seeded-QA auto-pause; TTFT p95 >1.5 s for 10 min; unverified numeric final observed in production; a Turn rendered with `lint_result.leak = true`. *Acceptance:* each alert has a staging fixture that fires it, and each has a runbook (08-DEGR-007 or 11.11) linked from the alert text.


# §09 Design system and UX specification ("every pixel")

## 09.1 Design principles
The interface is a pedagogical instrument. Calm removes extraneous load; speed keeps feedback inside the window where the Attempt is still in working memory; one visible next action is the visual form of "one move per Turn". Every token and component below serves one of those three. Each principle is a rule plus the test a reviewer runs; a PR that fails the test does not merge.

| ID | Principle | Rule | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| 09-PRIN-001 | Calm by default, expressive by exception | Motion, colour and celebration budgets are spent only on rare moments; the product has exactly one celebratory animation (a paper first reaching Exam-ready). | grep the animation registry: one entry tagged `celebrate`; no confetti/particle code in the bundle. |
| 09-PRIN-002 | The source is one gesture away | Every claim about a syllabus, mark scheme, examiner report or textbook carries a citation chip that opens the exact page. | Sample 50 assistant paragraphs with syllabus claims: 50 chips; chip → highlighted page ≤400 ms p95 from cache. |
| 09-PRIN-003 | Reading is the primary activity | Body text 17 px/1.55 at ≤68 ch in chat; 18/1.6 at ≤66 ch in the reader; nothing anywhere wider than 75 ch. | Playwright measures the widest paragraph on every screen at 1280, 1600 and 2560 px. |
| 09-PRIN-004 | Mode is visible and cannot be lost | The Learn · Practise · Mark chip is always in the composer; no study toggle exists anywhere. | Five new users name the current mode within 3 s in a moderated test; no `study_mode` boolean in settings. |
| 09-PRIN-005 | One move, then the pen comes back | A Turn ends with the composer focused and its placeholder naming the next action. | 100 sampled Turns: composer focused after paint in 100%; placeholder ≠ default in ≥90%. |
| 09-PRIN-006 | Evidence on the page | A Mark highlights credited, partial and uncredited spans inside the student's own answer; a credited point without a span is a defect. | Mark eval fixture: 0 credited points without `credited_spans[]`; each span resolves to a DOM range. |
| 09-PRIN-007 | A band, not a point | Totals render as low–modal–high; a single integer total never appears without its band. | Visual regression on Mark view: band present in every fixture including points papers ("7–8 / 9"). |
| 09-PRIN-008 | Hierarchy over recency | The sidebar is Course › Unit › Syllabus point; Recent and Due are secondary groups. | Sidebar snapshot: tree first; no chat list as the primary group. |
| 09-PRIN-009 | Instant acknowledgement, honest waiting | Optimistic echo <50 ms; status text at 800 ms; "Taking longer" + Stop at 6 s; no decorative loaders. | Synthetic 3 s TTFT: three states observed at the right times in a recorded trace. |
| 09-PRIN-010 | Stability while streaming | DOM above the stream cursor is immutable; unclosed math/code is held as a skeleton. | CLS above cursor = 0 in the jank test on 20 golden streams. |
| 09-PRIN-011 | Borders first, shadows second | Surfaces are defined by 1 px hairlines; stacked soft shadows only on floating layers; no shadows on list cards. | Stylelint: `box-shadow` only via `--shadow-*` tokens; shadow-2+ forbidden on `.card-list *`. |
| 09-PRIN-012 | Grey dark mode with a ladder | Dark surfaces are a five-step grey ladder from 16% L; never `#000`; elevation = lighter surface. | Token test: no dark token with L <14%; every pair passes contrast. |
| 09-PRIN-013 | Accessibility numbers are tokens | 24 px targets, 44 pt touch, 2 px/3:1 focus, 4.5:1 text, 320 px reflow are CSS tokens and CI gates, not guidelines. | axe + custom checks green on every PR; failing check blocks merge. |
| 09-PRIN-014 | Keyboard-complete, thumb-complete | Every action has a key on desktop and sits in the bottom 40% of the screen on a phone. | Keyboard traversal script completes each screen's primary flow; mobile primary controls within the thumb zone in screenshots. |
| 09-PRIN-015 | Progress is evidence and reversible | Mastery is four states by shape with a reason; it decays and says why; no bare percentages, no streaks. | Copy corpus policy test: zero strings matching the streak/shame lexicon; no `%` in mastery components. |
| 09-PRIN-016 | Respect attention | ≤1 opt-in factual notification per day; none in Quiet Hours; never loss-framed, never a predicted grade. | Notification scheduler unit test; copy lint on notification templates. |
| 09-PRIN-017 | Math and handwriting are native | LaTeX in, KaTeX + MathML out, keypad and camera are composer states; photo → confirmed transcript before any Mark. | 200-formula render suite incl. `mhchem`; no Mark request without `transcript_confirmed=true`. |
| 09-PRIN-018 | One reading-preference set everywhere | Family, size, leading, tracking, measure are set once and honoured by chat, reader, Cards and print. | Change each preference; screenshot chat, reader, Card, print preview: all reflect it. |
| 09-PRIN-019 | Numbers are honest and tabular | Every changing number uses tabular numerals; every estimate names its basis (series, n, agreement). | Font-feature audit on timers, countdowns, marks; calibration line present on every Mark. |
| 09-PRIN-020 | Limits are visible, never sudden | Usage shows in plain numbers; slow-down replaces hard stops; exam-week grace is stated. | Simulate quota exhaustion mid-Session: no modal, no stop; factual line and cheap-tier continuation. |

Why: the praised 2025–26 redesigns (Linear, Gemini's larger type) reduced noise and raised hierarchy; the criticised ones (pulsing "thinking" backgrounds, flat recency sidebars) added motion or clutter with no task benefit (research/ux-design §0). Students' top interface complaints are walls of text and busy screens (student-voice §0.8, §9).

## 09.2 Typography tokens
**09-TYPE-001** Families. Ship exactly these, self-hosted, subset for Latin + Cyrillic + Cyrillic-ext + Greek + math symbols; no CDN fonts.

| Token | Family | Role | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--font-sans` | Inter (variable, `opsz` axis) → system-ui | UI and reading default at launch | `font-feature-settings: "cv11", "ss03"` off by default; `tnum` on numbers. Default change to a serif only after the v1 reading-fatigue A/B (JUDGING 12). |
| `--font-hyper` | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (variable, 7 weights) | Reading-comfort option | 150+ languages; b/d remain mirrored, so it is a low-vision face, not a dyslexia cure. |
| `--font-dys` | OpenDyslexic | Reading-comfort option | Individual font effects are real (Wallace et al. 2022) — offer choice, never one "dyslexia font". |
| `--font-serif` | Literata → PT Serif → Georgia | Optional reading face | Must have true Cyrillic italics (09-I18N-004). |
| `--font-mono` | Geist Mono → JetBrains Mono → ui-monospace | Code, LaTeX source, `ecf`/annotation badges | Slashed zero on. |

**09-TYPE-002** Scale (px / line-height). Use only these tokens; arbitrary `font-size` values fail stylelint.

| Token | Size/LH | Use | Measure |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--text-xs` | 12/1.35 | captions, chip numerals, interval hints | — |
| `--text-sm` | 13/1.4 | status lines, metadata, calibration badge, mode-chip labels | — |
| `--text-ui` | 14/1.43 | controls, sidebar rows, table cells | — |
| `--text-body` | 17/1.55 | chat Turns, Mark rationale | 68 ch (≈720 px Inter) |
| `--text-read` | 18/1.6 | reader, student answer in Mark view, Card back | 66 ch |
| `--text-focus` | 20/1.6 | reader "Focus" | 60 ch |
| `--text-lg` | 20/1.4 | Card face body | — |
| `--text-h3` | 20/1.3 · 600 | maximum heading inside a Turn | — |
| `--text-h2` | 24/1.25 · 600 | screen section titles | — |
| `--text-h1` | 30/1.2 · 600 | screen titles | — |
| `--text-display` | 36/1.1 · 600, tracking −0.02 em | landing line only | — |

Tracking: display −0.02 em; body 0; caps labels +0.06 em. Paragraph gap 0.75 em in chat, 1 em in reader; no first-line indent. Lists 4 px between items, marker inset 1.25 em. Nothing under 12 px anywhere; nothing under 11 pt on iOS.

**09-TYPE-003** Tabular numerals. `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on timers, countdowns, marks, bands, due counts, intervals, thresholds and every table numeric column; numeric columns right-aligned. Acceptance: a timer counting from 09:59 to 10:00 does not shift the characters to its right.

**09-TYPE-004** Headings inside assistant content are capped at `--text-h3`; `h1`/`h2` from model markdown are demoted at render. Why: a Turn is not a landing page; students name "walls" as a top pain.

**09-TYPE-005** Weights: 400 body, 500 UI labels and modal marks, 600 headings and the bold modal number in a band. Never 300 or lighter; never 700+ except the modal mark in a band.

**09-TYPE-006** Glyph coverage. CI renders the sentence "Ә Ғ Қ Ң Ө Ұ Ү Һ І — Қазақстан, Өскемен; ёж, щука, ъ" plus "∑ ∫ ≤ ≥ ≠ → ⇌ ° µ" in every family and fails on any fallback glyph (see 09-I18N-002).

**09-TYPE-007** Text-spacing survival. Every screen survives WCAG 1.4.12 (line-height 1.5×, paragraph 2×, letter +0.12 em, word +0.16 em) and 200% font scaling without clipping or overlap. Acceptance: Playwright injects the text-spacing stylesheet; no element reports `scrollWidth > clientWidth` except tables, code and PDF pages.

## 09.3 Spacing, radii, sizes and elevation
**09-SPCE-001** Spacing is a 4 px base; only these tokens: `--space-1..16` = 4 8 12 16 20 24 32 40 48 64. Component internals may use 2 px only for hairline offsets (focus ring offset, chip padding-inline 6 px counts as 4+2). Stylelint rejects any margin/padding/gap not expressed as a token.

**09-SPCE-002** Radii: `--radius-xs` 4 (keycaps, code inline) · `-sm` 6 (rows, chips, citation chips) · `-md` 8 (buttons, inputs) · `-lg` 12 (composer, cards) · `-xl` 16 (user message block, sheets top corners) · `-2xl` 20 (large panels) · `-pill` 9999 (mode chip, intent chips, tags). Nested radii: inner = outer − padding, never larger than outer.

**09-SPCE-003** Sizes.

| Token | px | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `--target-min` | 24 | every pointer target (WCAG 2.5.8) |
| `--touch-min` | 44 | every target on coarse pointers |
| `--control-h` | 36 | buttons, inputs, palette input, effort dial |
| `--control-h-lg` | 44 | primary CTA on mobile, sheet buttons |
| `--row-h` | 32 | sidebar rows, palette rows, tree rows |
| `--chip-h` | 32 | mode chip, intent chips |
| `--cite-h` | 18 | citation chip (24 px hit area) |
| `--composer-min` | 56 | composer at rest; grows to 8 lines |
| `--topbar-h` | 48 desktop / 44 mobile | |
| `--tabstrip-h` | 40 | right-pane tab strip |
| `--rail-w` | 48 | collapsed right pane |
| `--sidebar-w` | 280 (240–360) | persisted per user |
| `--panel-w` | 480 (360–640) | persisted per user |
| `--pip` | 10 | mastery pip |
| `--ring` | 64, 4 px stroke | readiness ring |
| `--card-btn-h` | 56 | flashcard Again / Got it |

**09-SPCE-004** Elevation is border-first. `--ring-hairline: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / .08)` (dark: `oklch(100% 0 0 / .08)`). `--shadow-1` = hairline (cards, inputs). `--shadow-2` = `0 1px 1px /.02, 0 2px 2px /.04` + hairline (popovers, hover cards, dropdown). `--shadow-3` = `0 2px 2px /.04, 0 8px 16px −4px /.04` + hairline (sheets, drawers). `--shadow-4` = `0 1px 1px /.02, 0 8px 16px −4px /.04, 0 24px 32px −8px /.06` + hairline (the rare modal). No single heavy drop; no shadow above 12% alpha; no shadows on cards inside lists or on the Turn canvas. Dark mode conveys elevation by surface step, not shadow strength.

**09-SPCE-005** Grid. Desktop ≥1280: `grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-w) 1fr var(--panel-w)`; between 1280 and 1600 the panel shrinks first to its minimum; above 1600 surplus goes to centre margins, never to the measure. Tablet 900–1279: `1fr 420px`, sidebar overlay. Mobile <900: one column. Acceptance: resize 1280→2560; centre paragraph width stays ≤68 ch throughout.

## 09.4 Colour roles (OKLCH, light and dark)
**09-COLR-001** All colour is OKLCH, expressed as semantic roles with Radix 12-step meaning (1–2 backgrounds · 3–5 component fills · 6–8 borders · 9–10 solids · 11–12 text). No raw colour literal outside `tokens.css`; stylelint enforces. One accent hue (250) in the whole product. AO cards, modes, trust badges and subjects are distinguished by label and shape, never by hue.

| Role | Light | Dark | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg-app` (1) | `98.5% .004 90` | `16% .006 260` | body |
| `--bg-subtle` (2) | `97% .004 90` | `19% .006 260` | sidebar, rail, PDF surround |
| `--bg-el` (3) | `94.5% .004 90` | `23% .007 260` | user message block, chips, active row |
| `--bg-el-hover` (4) | `92% .004 90` | `26% .007 260` | |
| `--bg-el-active` (5) | `89% .005 90` | `29% .008 260` | |
| `--border-subtle` (6) | `88% .005 90` | `27% .008 260` | table rows |
| `--border` (7) | `83% .006 90` | `32% .009 260` | inputs, cards |
| `--border-strong` (8) | `74% .008 90` | `42% .01 260` | focus ring outer |
| `--accent` (9) | `55% .16 250` (white text) | `72% .13 250` (text `16%`) | Send, primary button, credited underline, progress bar |
| `--accent-hover` (10) | `50% .16 250` | `76% .13 250` | |
| `--accent-subtle` | `95% .03 250` | `26% .04 250` | credited wash, selected chip |
| `--text-muted` (11) | `48% .01 90` (≥Lc 60 on step 2) | `70% .01 260` | metadata, hints |
| `--text` (12) | `20% .012 90` (≥Lc 90) | `94% .005 260` | |
| `--success` | `60% .14 150` | `72% .12 150` | Secure/Exam-ready pip fill, "Got it", ✓ glyph |
| `--warning` | `75% .15 80` (text on it `20%`) | `80% .13 80` | uncredited dotted underline, ER blockquote rule, provisional badge |
| `--danger` | `58% .19 25` | `70% .16 25` | destructive confirm, × glyph, offline banner icon; never a heatmap tone |
| `--highlight-source` | `90% .14 95 / .35` | `85% .14 95 / .40` | cited span in the reader |
| `--highlight-select` | `88% .10 250 / .30` | `70% .10 250 / .35` | user text selection in reader |
| `--scrim` | `0% 0 0 / .40` | `0% 0 0 / .55` | sheets, overlays |

**09-COLR-002** Mastery pip colours. State is carried by shape (empty ring · ¼ · ¾ · full disc) and colour reinforces: Unseen ring `--border`; Shaky ¼ `--warning`; Secure ¾ `--success`; Exam-ready full `--success` with a 1 px `--text` outline. A decaying Secure pip (retrievability <0.7) renders Shaky by shape and colour together. Acceptance: pips remain distinguishable in a greyscale screenshot.

**09-COLR-003** Heatmap: five tones of one hue — `oklch(93% .03 250)`, `86% .07`, `76% .11`, `64% .14`, `52% .16` (dark: `24% .03 250` → `72% .13`) — mapped to learning events per day; empty day = `--bg-el`. Never red; never a streak count.

**09-COLR-004** Span marking colours: credited = 2 px underline `--accent` + `--accent-subtle` wash; partial = 2 px dotted `--accent`; uncredited attempt = 2 px dotted `--warning`; ECF = `--accent` underline with `ecf` mono badge. Hover/focus on any span raises the wash one step and shows the reason.

**09-COLR-005** Contrast+ variant: text 12 → `10% / 98%`, borders +1 step, `--text-muted` → `36% / 80%`, all alphas ×1.3, hairlines 1.5 px. Ships with both themes at launch.

**09-COLR-006** CI runs an APCA/WCAG matrix over every text-role × surface-role pair in light, dark and Contrast+; any pair below 4.5:1 (3:1 for ≥24 px/19 px bold and for UI borders/focus rings) fails the build.

## 09.5 Motion
**09-MOTN-001** Durations and easings are tokens; a lint forbids any `transition`/`animation` that does not use them.

```css
--dur-press: 120ms;   /* :active scale .97, chip select */
--dur-tooltip: 150ms; /* tooltips, selection popover, hover card (120ms allowed for cite card) */
--dur-fast: 180ms;    /* dropdown, popover, toast in */
--dur-base: 220ms;    /* delta fade-in, card expand, tab switch */
--dur-page: 260ms;    /* route transitions (mobile push) */
--dur-drawer: 320ms;  /* sheets, sidebar overlay, right pane open */
--dur-celebrate: 400ms; /* the one two-tone ring fade */
--stagger: 40ms;      /* max 6 items staggered */
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);
--ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1);
--ease-drawer: cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1);
--spring-gesture: { type: spring, duration: .5, bounce: .15 }  /* drag-to-dismiss only */
```

**09-MOTN-002** Rules: animate only `transform`, `opacity` and `clip-path`; entrances start at scale .96 (never 0) from `transform-origin` at the trigger; exits run ~20% faster than entrances; elements that move together share duration and easing; hover effects only under `(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)`; no transition exceeds 320 ms except the single 400 ms celebration.

**09-MOTN-003** Zero-animation actions (an animation here is a defect): Send/Stop swap, message append, command palette open/close, any keyboard-initiated action, tab switch in the right pane, mode-chip change, pip state change, flashcard button press, timer ticks, sidebar row selection.

**09-MOTN-004** Forbidden: `ease-in` on UI, `scale(0)`, bounce or overshoot outside drag-to-dismiss, pulsing or gradient "thinking" backgrounds, typing-cursor blink faster than 1 Hz, shimmer >1.6 s loop, parallax, auto-playing loops, confetti, particles, mascots, loss animations, layout-affecting animations (height/width/margin).

**09-MOTN-005** Reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, or forced in Settings): all transforms removed; opacity/colour fades only at ≤160 ms; skeleton shimmer off; sheets appear in place; flashcard flip becomes a 150 ms crossfade; the celebration becomes a 400 ms colour change. Acceptance: Playwright run with reduced motion records no element whose bounding box changes during any transition.

**09-MOTN-006** Haptics (mobile): light impact on card flip and Got it; selection tick on keypad keys; none on Again, on Marks or on any tutor error — the product never punishes.

## 09.6 Iconography
**09-ICON-001** One outline family (Lucide), 24 px grid, 2 px stroke, 1 px optical padding; 16 and 20 px optical variants for dense rows; icon colour = the text colour of its row; never two families on one surface; no filled variants except the Send button glyph and the active mode segment.

**09-ICON-002** Marking glyphs are typographic, never emoji: ✓ (credited), × (uncredited), Ø (nothing creditable), BOD, ECF, NC, CON, RE, GA, I rendered as 16 px `--font-mono` 600 margin badges; ✓ uses `--success`, × `--danger`, the rest `--text-muted`. Every glyph has a tooltip and `aria-label` with the full phrase ("Error carried forward").

**09-ICON-003** Trust badges are text badges (Syllabus · Endorsed textbook · Mark scheme · Examiner report · Revision notes · Your notes) at `--text-xs` 500 caps, `--bg-el` fill, radius 4, never coloured by rank. Provenance chips (OWN · LICENSED · USER) appear only in Library and teacher views.

**09-ICON-004** Emoji are banned from system copy, icons and model output (lint, 09-COPY-006). The only permitted symbols are typographic (· — → ✓ × ▸ ↓ ¼ ¾ ∑).

## 09.7 Component inventory and states
**09-COMP-001** Build the components below as one package (`@margin/ui`) on shadcn primitives under the token skin [founder default, E13/E15 — §15.G]. Every component ships with every state listed, a Storybook story per state, and an axe test. States use the shared vocabulary: `default · hover · focus-visible · active · disabled · loading · streaming · error · offline · gated · empty · selected`.

| Component | Anatomy (px) | States and rules |
|---|---|---|
| **Composer** | 56 rest → 8 lines; padding 12/16; radius 12; hairline border; focus ring step-8. Left: `+` (36) and **ModeChip**. Right: **EffortDial** (28, Quick · Think · Deep, ↗ badge when maths auto-escalates), mic (v1, hidden at MVP), camera, **Send** (36, the only filled button; becomes **Stop** in place, same size). | `text` (Aa) · `math` (MathLive field, 5×4 keypad / 10×4 landscape, 24 px live preview line, decimal comma accepted) · `camera` (see 10.8) · `voice` (v1). `streaming` disables Send only; typing continues. `offline`: Send → "Will send" queue tag. `gated` (levels-Mark quota): camera and Mark mode show reason tooltips, Learn stays enabled. Slash menu (`/learn /practise /mark /quiz /paper /card`). Quiet token hint appears only in the last 15% of a session budget. |

| **IntentRow** | 3 outline chips 32 h, radius pill, gap 8, under the tutor's Turn | rendered only while a gradable Item is open; **Just the answer** `disabled` before one attempt with tooltip "After one attempt."; keys 1/2/3; disappears when the Attempt closes. |
| **Turn (assistant)** | text on canvas, no bubble; ≤120 words; four-line order right → diagnosis → move → hand-back (behavioural) | `streaming` (cursor block 2 px `--accent`, 1 Hz) · `linted` (regenerated silently) · `template` (fallback after second lint fail, tagged for telemetry) · `error` inline card. Hover/focus reveals MessageActions (copy, retry, explain simpler, quiz me, show in book) as 12 px icons in 24 px targets; on touch a single ⋯. |

Rung 5 shows a **Seen solution · retest Thu** tag afterwards. Resets per Item. |

| **AOCard** | label "AO3 Analysis" · "Level 2 of 3 · 4/6" · descriptor relied on (our paraphrase) · quoted spans list · confidence dot | `skeleton` (fixed height until its card streams, ≤8 s each) · `credited` · `capped` · `provisional`. Distinguished by label, never hue. Points papers: M/A/B rows with `ecf` badge. |

Hard/Easy behind a setting. Provenance line on every card. |
